ERR-USER-001.title: User Not Found
ERR-USER-001.description: The requested user does not exist in the database or could not be located.
recovery_steps: Verify the user ID or Telegram user ID is correct
Check if the user has completed /start command to register
Try using /start to create a new user account
ERR-USER-001.example: User with Telegram ID 123456789 not found in the system

ERR-USER-002.title: User Unauthorized
ERR-USER-002.description: The user does not have permission to perform this action or access this resource.
recovery_steps: Ensure you have completed the initial setup with /setup_discord
Verify your Discord token is valid and active
Contact the administrator if you believe this is an error

ERR-DISCORD-001.title: Discord Token Invalid
ERR-DISCORD-001.description: The provided Discord user token is invalid, expired, or has been revoked.
recovery_steps: Obtain a fresh Discord user token from your browser
Use /setup_discord command to update your token
Ensure the token is copied completely without extra spaces
Verify the token format matches: 'MTxxxxxxxxx.xxxxxx.xxxxxxxxxxx'
ERR-DISCORD-001.example: Use browser DevTools > Network > XHR > Look for 'authorization' header

ERR-DISCORD-002.title: Discord Connection Failed
ERR-DISCORD-002.description: Unable to establish or maintain connection to Discord Gateway. This may be due to network issues, Discord API downtime, or authentication problems.
recovery_steps: Check your internet connection
Verify Discord API status at https://discordstatus.com
Wait a few minutes and the system will attempt to reconnect automatically
If the issue persists, update your Discord token using /setup_discord

ERR-CHANNEL-001.title: Invalid Channel ID
ERR-CHANNEL-001.description: The specified Discord channel ID is malformed or does not exist.
recovery_steps: Verify the channel ID is a valid Discord snowflake (numeric string)
Enable Developer Mode in Discord settings to copy channel IDs
Right-click the channel and select 'Copy ID'
Ensure the channel exists and you have access to it

ERR-CHANNEL-002.title: Channel Not in Allowlist
ERR-CHANNEL-002.description: The channel is not in your monitoring allowlist. Messages from non-allowlisted channels are ignored to reduce noise.
recovery_steps: Use /allow_channel command to add the channel to your allowlist
Verify the channel ID is correct
Check your current allowlist with /settings command

ERR-DB-001.title: Database Connection Failed
ERR-DB-001.description: Unable to connect to or query the PostgreSQL database. This is a critical system error that prevents normal operation.
recovery_steps: Check if the database container is running: docker ps
Verify database credentials in .env file
Check database logs: docker logs moderator-db
Restart the database container if needed
Contact system administrator if the issue persists

ERR-REPLY-001.title: Failed to Post Reply
ERR-REPLY-001.description: Unable to post the moderator's reply to the target platform (Discord or Telegram). This may be due to API errors, rate limiting, or invalid content.
recovery_steps: Use the 'Retry' button to attempt posting again
Check if your message contains valid content and attachments
Verify the target channel/chat still exists and is accessible
Wait a moment if rate limiting is in effect
Contact support if retries continue to fail

ERR-SYSTEM-001.title: Invalid Usage
ERR-SYSTEM-001.description: The command or action was used incorrectly or with invalid parameters.
recovery_steps: Check the command syntax and required parameters
Use /help to see available commands and their usage
Refer to the documentation for detailed examples

ERR-SYSTEM-002.title: Generic Error
ERR-SYSTEM-002.description: An unexpected error occurred. This is a catch-all error for unhandled exceptions.
recovery_steps: Try the action again after a brief wait
Check the application logs for more details
Report the issue with the Request ID if it persists
Contact system administrator for assistance
